This indicates that the business objective of minimizing deadline breaches, which was not explicitly part of R0 but is implied by the operational context, conflicts with the pure FIFO implementation.
answer.suggested_requirement_change: Modify R0 to prioritize deadline adherence over strict FIFO ordering when deadlines are critical for business outcomes, while maintaining other constraints such as reviewer eligibility, duration, daily hours, and no overtime. The new requirement should specify that cases with earlier deadlines take precedence over later ones, even if they arrive after later-due cases.
